I've run a query for every task and checked each one's output. The last thing I did was T14. Here are the queries.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | * /name
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | * count
T4: /data/users | * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | mul 100 | round | div 100
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | flat | * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce null | at :login)}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | * count
T8: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | * (entries) | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | * ([(/0 | print | drop 1) "@" /1] | join "")
T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(ne "") | * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) | * count
T11: lines | * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10
T12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | * (split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | * {:c /1 :s (/5 | lower) :t (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson))} | filter ~(/s | eq "shipped") | * /t | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
T13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | * (split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | * {:c /1 :s (/5 | lower) :t (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson))} | filter ~(/s | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/c) | entries | * {:customer (/0 | print | drop 1) :total (/1 | * /t | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100)} | sort ~([(/total | desc) /customer]) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
